name: David Keci
description: When I discovered software, I saw how much impact it can create. It is not only about writing code, but about understanding problems, building useful solutions, and creating digital experiences that make things easier for people.

I graduated in Software Engineering and now specialize in Web Engineering. Through different projects and work experiences, I have developed myself as both a developer and a problem solver. I enjoy working on ideas from the first concept to the final product, combining technical skills, design thinking, and attention to detail.

For me, software is a way to turn knowledge into real solutions. The more I learn, the more I understand how powerful technology can be when it is built with purpose. What makes software different is that it gives you the ability to create something from information, logic, and creativity, then turn it into a product people can actually use. This is what motivates me to keep improving, work on different kinds of projects, and grow with every challenge.

cards.title: Software Engineer
cards.body: I like coding, I like being professional, but mostly I like growing.

cards.title: Creative Engineering
cards.body: I am passionate about growing as a software engineer and learning how great products create real impact.

cards.title: Details Matter
cards.body: Great products are built from thousands of small right decisions — I care deeply about making each one count.

cards.title: Product Thinking
cards.body: I think about software the way a product person would — who uses it, why it matters, and how it scales.

cards.title: Fast Learner
cards.body: I am calm by nature, thrive in collaborative settings, and pick up new technologies faster than most.
